purpose: M4 same-board sampling frozen before performance timing
boundary: Resident pre-tokenized IDs through greedy token-ID delivery in a Python list. Includes reset for prefill/generation, complete model arithmetic, all metadata, packing, dispatch, DMA/cache, KV maintenance, full logits and greedy selection. Excludes text tokenization/detokenization, external networking/UI and independent validation.
cached_decode_setup: Restore the same 13-token prefix KV/K8/units and logical length outside timing; process the frozen first generated token and deliver the second. Setup is explicit, not a claim that KV preparation is free.
generation_sampling_rationale: Three complete 20-token chain trials per backend, after three fixed-workload warmups, limit multi-hour board occupancy. Diagnostic correctness runs already indicate seconds-to-tens-of-seconds per token. Twenty independent trials remain mandatory for each fixed headline workload. Full-chain sample size is three, not sixty; report every trial and avoid precise tail inference from three samples.
primitive_sampling: Three warmups and twenty trials per backend/case. All seven M3 SFPU operations and representative K=3072 and vocabulary-tail GEMMs. Scalar-versus-batched V requantization at lengths 13, 32, 1024, width 64, same signed-int16 deterministic inputs, exact codes/effective units checked outside timing.
profile: Non-overlapping wall spans around complete backend GEMM and SFPU calls; residual host wall is total minus those spans. Hardware cycle counters overlap DMA and are reported separately, never added to wall spans.
cold_policy: Report process initialization/integrity checking separately and retain warmup times. Hash verification warms page cache; no disk-cold or global cache-drop claim. No governor, swap, clock or global OS tuning.
statistics: Retain all raw trials and ordering; median, linear-interpolated p95, minimum, maximum, mean and population standard deviation. CPU/FPGA latency ratio greater than one means offload faster. No outlier removal or minimum-speedup gate.
limitations: Single fixed prompt/context performance does not establish performance at all context lengths; full-context execution is a separate correctness/memory test. Matching native integer CPU baseline is not original FP32 GPT-2 or a claim of fastest possible ARM code. Primitive batching proof is not an integrated speedup attribution.
